messages:
olivia_support: Heads-up — customer (org: org_88, project: proj-21) just hit 429s but their Project quota tile shows ~20% usage. Customer says dashboard shows 50k tokens left but API is rejecting. :confused:
priyanka_billing: Can you paste org_id / project_id + an invoice or usage window? I can pre-check billing side.
olivia_support: org_88 / proj-21. Customer quoted timestamps: "2026-03-15T13:02:00Z" -> "2026-03-15T13:18:00Z". Invoice ref: INV-2026-03-15-88 (they attached screenshot) https://s3.redwood-infra/internal/support/INV-2026-03-15-88.png
jorge_sre: @olivia_support thanks. A couple quick questions: are the 429s strictly from rate-limit responses or quota enforcement (429 vs 403/402)? and is the 429 body the standard rate_limit JSON?
olivia_support: It's 429 with body {"error":"quota_exceeded","type":"token_limit"} — customer says they saw two spikes that correlate with a batch job.
priyanka_billing: I'll cross-check invoiced tokens vs realtime meter. One common source is delayed ingestion into the org-aggregator which can make dashboard tiles lag behind enforcement. Can you grab the raw request IDs or a sample request header?
olivia_support: sample request-id: req_20260315_8f3d. Attached logs: ```
[2026-03-15T13:05:12Z] req_20260315_8f3d project=proj-21 tokens=12000
[2026-03-15T13:05:13Z] req_20260315_8f3d project=proj-21 tokens=48000
[2026-03-15T13:05:14Z] quota-enforcer project=proj-21 status=429 remaining=0
```
jorge_sre: OK running quick check against the metering DB, can you hold on? I want to compare raw token ingests vs dashboard rollups. Quick SQL I ran in staging to emulate aggregation: ```
SELECT window_start, project_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_ingest
WHERE org_id='org_88' AND window_start >= '2026-03-15T12:00:00Z'
GROUP BY window_start, project_id
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
matt_product: Could this be the per-project burst policy? If aggregator applies different windows for project vs org, the project tile might show per-project moving-window while enforcement uses an immediate rolling counter.
jorge_sre: Exactly — preliminary find: the org-aggregator service (quota_aggregator v2.4.1) had a drift bug when ingesting timestamps that arrive delayed by >30s. It sometimes emits the same bucket into two adjacent minute-windows, which undercounts project-level tile (which uses last-minute snapshot) but double-counts in the enforcement rolling counter. That results in enforcement firing earlier than dashboard reflects. :grimacing:
ops-bot: [AUTOMATED ALERT] quota_aggregator_v2.4.1 error rate spike detected at 2026-03-15T13:06:00Z — 240 errors/min.
priyanka_billing: If that's the issue we should flag invoices for that window and prepare a credit. I'll start a provisional ledger hold for proj-21 and note potential correction.
jorge_sre: Patch ready (hotfix): https://git.internal.redwood/p/quota_aggregator/merge_requests/1422 — fixes bucketing on delayed ingestion and adds a backfill job. Plan: deploy canary now, run backfill for org_88, then promote. Mitigations: 1) run backfill for the 13:00-13:30 window, 2) restart quota-enforcer to pick up corrected rollups, 3) temporary loosen soft-limits for proj-21 until backfill completes.
olivia_support: ETA on canary -> prod? Customer is asking for timeline, they want credits if this will take long.
jorge_sre: Canary deployed to k8s/infra-canary in 5m, backfill job estimated 8-10m for that window. If canary looks good I'll promote in ~15m. I'll post logs here.
priyanka_billing: I'll prepare a provisional credit for the window and wait for final backfilled numbers. Please tag me when the backfill finishes so I can reconcile invoices.
matt_product: Recommend we proactively notify affected customers (proj-21 and any orgs with ingestion latency >30s in that day). Could be a handful.
jorge_sre: Canary logs: ```
[13:12:30Z] quota_aggregator_v2.4.1-hotfix started
[13:12:35Z] backfill job queued for org_88 window 13:00-13:30
[13:18:00Z] backfill job finished, delta tokens corrected: -62000 (org rollup decreased)
```
priyanka_billing: Delta -62000 confirmed, initiating credit for proj-21 and updating invoice INV-2026-03-15-88. I'll follow up with accounting. :white_check_mark:
olivia_support: I told the customer we've identified the issue, hotfix canary deployed and backfill completed, credits being issued. They appreciate fast turnaround. :relieved:
jorge_sre: Will still push prod deploy after 15m smoke tests. Opening follow-up: MR-1422 will be cherry-picked to main, deploy pipeline will run, and a postmortem created.
olivia_support: Thanks all — closing thread after prod promo. Please ping if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
